declarations.state_ownership: Owns content_drafts (migration 0041) and content_sources (0042) in lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations, and the content defaults on wp_sites (0039, 0040, 0044; organization_id added by 0061). Social-publish idempotency rows live in media_delivery_attempts (0065, 0068), shared with video through lib/content/video/delivery-receipts.ts. Text-LLM usage rows go to the platform table ai_call_logs (0043, lib/ai/log-ai-call.ts:2), which content writes but does not own. Channels are read from social_accounts, which social owns.
declarations.behavior_ownership: Writing, checking and publishing articles: lib/content/article/generate-core.ts (article generation), quality/seo-check-core.ts (SEO check), publish/wordpress-core.ts (one WordPress publish core for the route and the headless block; header), trending-sources.ts (topic search blocks), pipeline.ts (headless article -> quality -> WordPress draft; header), blocks/registry.ts (self-registering content blocks), postiz.ts (social channels and posting through Postiz). The HTTP shells are app/api/content/* (brand-voice, outline, title, keywords, humanize, seo-fix, syndicate, market-analysis, trending, image, newsletter, publish, social-publish, drafts, sources, sites and more).
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP: /api/content/* route handlers (26 route.ts files under app/api/content); paid ones are wrapped by withFeature("content.<feature>") or call grantFor (e.g. app/api/content/humanize/route.ts:27, lib/content/article/generate-core.ts:788). Outbound: WordPress REST or the signed wp-bridge /post (lib/content/publish/wordpress-core.ts:313), FluentCRM newsletters through the bridge (app/api/content/newsletter/route.ts:3), the Postiz public API (lib/content/postiz.ts:38-39). No Trigger task and no inbound webhook (packages/workflows/src/trigger has no content task).
declarations.invariants: WordPress publishing is draft-first: status defaults to draft, publish and future are explicit (lib/content/publish/wordpress-core.ts:38, :313); the production-change gate runs before any write to the site (wordpress-core.ts:365-367). A site from the environment fallback has no owner and is fail-closed for client users (lib/content/wp-sites.ts:11-13). Social publishing reserves idempotent delivery rows before calling Postiz, so a retried request cannot post twice (app/api/content/social-publish/route.ts:164). Every paid AI call needs a grant; the provider SDK loaders refuse without one (lib/ai/gateway.ts header).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (tables above), postiz (social-publish and channel listing, lib/content/postiz.ts), WordPress sites of the customer (WP REST or wp-bridge, WPBRIDGE_* read in lib/payments/woo.ts:86-89), image generation through the shared toolkit lib/tarot/image-gen.ts and R2 storage lib/storage/r2.ts:30-37 (app/api/content/image/route.ts), Anthropic (loadAnthropic; app/api/content/brand-voice/route.ts:42), OpenAI (article generation, generate-core.ts:789), Serper for source links (generate-core.ts:196). Uses collect's remote-file fetcher for media (lib/content/postiz.ts:3), same app, no new service. products.ts dependsOn is empty. Video rendering is the separate video product. Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row content.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: Trending topic blocks run with Promise.allSettled, so one failing source does not empty the list (lib/content/trending-sources.ts:379); a malformed CONTENT_TRENDING_FEEDS only drops the custom feeds and logs a warning (trending-sources.ts:362-364). A missing SERPER_API_KEY yields no source links instead of failing generation (generate-core.ts:196-197); a missing OPENAI_API_KEY ends the stream with a marked error (generate-core.ts:789-791). A WordPress site that is not configured returns 503 for that request only (wordpress-core.ts:359).
declarations.data_lifecycle: content_drafts are hard-deleted by DELETE /api/content/drafts, scoped to the row's organization (app/api/content/drafts/route.ts:211-236); content_sources are read-only to the route (app/api/content/sources/route.ts:57-65). Published articles live in the customer's WordPress, not here. ai_call_logs retention is the platform's.
declarations.observability_contract: Every text-LLM call writes ai_call_logs with route and exact usage (lib/ai/log-ai-call.ts:2, :59); image calls log their cost (app/api/content/image/route.ts:17). Social-publish keeps a delivery receipt per destination in media_delivery_attempts (lib/content/video/delivery-receipts.ts:76). Feed configuration errors are logged, not swallowed (trending-sources.ts:363).
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: Migrations 0061, 0065 and 0068 have a down script in lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts (<n>_down.sql, run by hand); 0039, 0040, 0041, 0042 and 0044 have no down file in either place (migrations/ or scripts/) and roll forward only.
declarations.replacement_strategy: Each capability is a content block that registers itself and talks only through ctx; adding one is one file calling register(), deleting the file removes it, and the orchestrator never changes (lib/content/blocks/registry.ts header, lib/content/blocks/README.md). WordPress transport switches between wp-bridge and REST inside one core (wordpress-core.ts header); Postiz is reached only through lib/content/postiz.ts; image providers sit behind lib/tarot/image-gen.ts.

configuration.apiKeys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY for text, REPLICATE_API_TOKEN (and OPENAI_API_KEY) for images through lib/tarot/image-gen.ts:406,540, R2_* for stored images (lib/storage/r2.ts:30-37), SERPER_API_KEY optional for source links, POSTIZ_* only for social publishing, WP_API_URL + WORDPRESS_JWT_TOKEN or WPBRIDGE_* only when publishing to the customer's WordPress (wordpress-core.ts:354-355, lib/payments/woo.ts:86-89), CONTENT_TRENDING_FEEDS optional JSON feed list (trending-sources.ts:13).
configuration.installUnit: Each services entry names the service this product calls; the installer installs that entry's whole compose file (ADR 017 section 5 inventory).
